raw.query: SELECT model, variate, avg(CASE WHEN h=1 THEN wape END) AS wape_h1, avg(CASE WHEN h=12 THEN wape END) AS wape_h12 FROM forecast_metrics WHERE span='common' AND candidate='point' GROUP BY model, variate
raw.observed: holt_winters WAPE h1->h12: ctx 0.755->1.050 (+39%), gen 0.663->0.933 (+41%), images 1.008->1.400 (+39%), requests 0.511->0.737 (+44%); naive +13-21%; only champion models (chronos/toto/timesfm) stay within +5-8%
raw.claimed: accuracy degrades only marginally across a twelve-step horizon covering the median burst onset
raw.evidence: Across the h=1..12 horizon in the common span, naive and holt_winters WAPE grows 13-44% (holt_winters ~+40%, nearly doubling on images) — far beyond 'marginal'; the claim only holds for the champion FM models.
